title: Liability Decision Table for Charge Reviews, Insulin Pump Program
content:
For a non-covered item charge reviewed on an Insulin Pump Program, the supported charge follows the tier and the reviewed line's liability records:

| Tier | Liability record | Effect on the standard of no supported part |
|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | the plan issued an organization determination denial for the line's item, recorded as a prior authorization denial for that item | replaced with every denied unit at the cash price per unit |
| any other tier | the newest liability notice signed against the line's grant was signed on or before the line's ship date | replaced with the lesser of the denied units and that notice's units at the cash price per unit |
| any tier | neither record | nothing is supported |

A notice signed after the ship date covers only later lines of the grant.

## Reading the table

- Only notices signed against the grant the reviewed line drew on are read, and of those the newest.
- When that newest notice was signed after the line's ship date, nothing is supported under it.
- On the Medicare Advantage tier only the plan's organization determination denial for the item supports a charge.

| Hypothetical reviewed line (12 denied A4225 units at $6.85) | Supported under this table |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare tier; newest notice for 10 units signed against the line's grant before the ship date | 10 units, $68.50 |
| Medicaid tier; no notice on file | nothing |
| Medicare Advantage tier; organization determination denial for the item | 12 units, $82.20 |
